flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds show Democrats as the favoured party to control the Senate, with their chances edging up slightly. The biggest move came in [[Nebraska]], where the Republican Pete Ricketts saw a sizable gain in the market's view. In [[Ohio]], the Democrat Sherrod Brown gained ground moderately in what the market treats as a predicted flip, and the Democrat Mary Peltola in [[Alaska]] also improved moderately, another predicted flip.
summaries.governor: The Republican in [[Nebraska]], Jim Pillen, saw a sharp rise in the Polymarket odds of holding the governor's office. Democrats Keisha Lance Bottoms in [[Georgia]] and Aaron Ford in [[Nevada]] each gained sizable ground, and the market treats both seats as predicted flips. In Florida, the Republican Byron Donalds slipped by a moderate amount.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show Democrats, the party the market favours to win House control, picking up a slight bit of ground. The biggest move came in [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], where the Republican Brad Knott's chances took a sharp drop. In [[FL-09 (Orlando & Kissimmee)]], the Republican Dan Green also lost a sizable amount of ground, and the market now shows a predicted flip there.
